<noinclude>
== Usage ==
<pre>{{Avatarian|k uh t ah r uh|Katara}}</pre>
Parameter 1 is the word in '''sounds''' (the readable codes the translator's
"Sounds" box takes; ARPAbet in CAPITALS or IPA also work); parameter 2 is the
English '''label''' shown on hover. Get the sounds by typing the word into the
[https://REPLACE-ME translator] and copying its "Sounds" box. With JavaScript
off, the plain label shows instead of the glyphs.
</noinclude><includeonly><span class="avatarian-word" data-avatarian-sounds="{{{1|}}}" data-avatarian-label="{{{2|}}}">{{{2|{{{1|}}}}}}</span></includeonly>
